title: PackagingTargets
description: Release build-input matrix (build side, P5-01). One entry per shipped artifact of xresconv-gui. Scope is frozen by decisions D1/D2 (docs/plan/records/P0-06.md): 64-bit only (no ia32/x86/armv7l); Linux first wave = Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Debian 12/13, Fedora 43/44 (latest two formal releases as of 2026-09-24, per endoflife.date/fedora). This file holds build-time identity/policy only; fields that can only be filled at build time (appVersion, sourceCommit, hashes, files, signingEvidence, buildToolchain, repositorySnapshot, verificationReport) live in the artifact-side runtime-manifest.json (schema packaging-runtime-manifest). Semantic rules (duplicates, baseline set equality, per-os strategy coherence) are enforced by @xresconv/packaging on top of this structural schema.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema file.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this targets file. Breaking changes must bump it.

targets.description: Explicit enumeration of every release target; CI aggregate jobs compare the built artifact set against this list for exact set equality (no globbing).

linuxDistro.description: Linux distribution series (D2 set). Required for linux/bootstrap targets; forbidden elsewhere (linux offline is one self-contained package per arch covering all D2 distros; windows/macos carry no distro).

os.description: Operating system family. Naming segment <os> uses this value verbatim.

osVersionRange.description: Supported OS version range for this target. windows: Windows build range (>=10.0.17763 = Windows 10 1809, WebView2-capable floor; calibrated in P5-03). macos: macOS version range (>=13.5 per D5 candidate, re-checked at P5-04). linux bootstrap: the exact distro series the artifact is built and verified on (mirrors distro). linux offline self-contained: the oldest supported baseline of the D2 set (>=22.04, i.e. Ubuntu 22.04 / glibc 2.35 floor).

arch.description: Machine architecture. windows/macos use Node-style names (x64, arm64); linux uses triple-style names (x86_64, aarch64) - narrowed per os by the conditional rules below. 32-bit values (ia32, x86, armv7l) are deliberately absent (D1).

variant.description: bootstrap: runtime prerequisites acquired online at install (WebView2 embedBootstrapper / distro package manager). offline: prerequisites carried in the package (WebView2 offlineInstaller / self-contained Linux bundle).

targetTriple.description: Rust target triple of the Tauri shell build for this target.

webviewStrategy.description: WebView provisioning strategy; the os/variant-coherent value is enforced semantically by @xresconv/packaging. windows: WebView2 via NSIS embedBootstrapper (bootstrap) or offlineInstaller (offline) per tauri.windows.*.conf.json overlays. macos: system-only (WKWebView ships with the OS, D5; no standalone webview installer). linux bootstrap: webkitgtk-system (WebKitGTK 4.1 from the distro). linux offline: webkitgtk-bundled (WebKitGTK/GTK and transitive deps carried in the self-contained package; P5-06 prototype, fallback = per-distro dependency closure).

minimumWebview.description: Minimum acceptable webview version gate. windows: WebView2 runtime floor 120.0.0 (frontend build target chrome120 in apps/desktop/vite.config.ts). macos: null (no separate webview version; the osVersionRange floor is the gate, D5). linux: WebKitGTK library floor 2.38 (API 4.1; feature gate calibrated on clean VMs in P5-05/P5-06).

nodeVersion.description: Bundled Node.js major line shipped inside every variant (repo engines: >=24.0.0). The exact version and its hash are pinned at build time into runtime-manifest.json (nodeVersion/nodeHash there).
